workflow_definitions.A: Autonomous — buildable_by_self_gen == 'yes'. Materialiser picks stub -> codegen writes module under components/generated/live/ -> verifier tests -> if verified, promoted to live automatically (dashboard reflects it) -> if failed, quarantined + auto-retried per PR CC.
workflow_definitions.B: Drafted-then-approved — buildable_by_self_gen starts with 'no_'. Same picker/queue, but codegen writes the proposed change to a sandbox branch (never live code) -> sandbox tests run (fix-proposer loop, Issue #220) -> if tests pass, DMAI opens a GitHub PR titled '[DMAI-DRAFT] ...' with description, diff scope, test evidence, and confidence score -> DMAI sends an in-app notification ('Draft fix ready for review: PR #NNN') -> human merges (approve) or closes (reject) -> DMAI records the outcome and updates its self-model of what fixes work.

seed_command: POST /api/admin/self-generation/seed-backlog?path=data/self_gen_backlog.jsonl (this endpoint DOES NOT EXIST YET — must be built as one of the priority-1 items in the backlog itself: see gap_seed_backlog_ingestion_endpoint)
